title: Same words, two voices
proves: Voice analysis changes the reading when the words are identical: one calm take, one shaking take.
summary: One short sentence recorded twice by the same person: once calm, once with a shaking, strained voice. The words are identical, so any difference in the reading comes from the voice.

steps.text: मैं ठीक हूँ। बस आज फिर रास्ते में उन लोगों से सामना हो गया।
steps.gloss: I am fine. It is just that today I ran into those people on the way again.

expected.note: The shaking take should show more voice strain and a higher SVI than the calm take. Voice can support a band but never make a case Critical alone (FR-VOI-08).
